rule12_eligibility.claim_under_test: Round 25's QCO gdept_z0 source association and the nemo_sco HPG acceleration interface are eligible to land only if the changed operator is bit-exact given NEMO's own inputs on EVERY card that executes it.
cards_that_execute_it: GYRE-zco (discharged in round 25: oracle_input_hpg = 0.0 on both components)
rule12_eligibility.lock_overflow_method: At kt=1 both lane-1 tanks start from rest. NEMO stage 1 accumulates dyn_hpg, dyn_vor and dyn_adv into a zeroed Krhs (stprk3_stg.F90:309-334); dyn_vor and dyn_adv are bilinear in the velocity, so at u=v=0 they contribute exactly zero and the dumped stage-1 Krhs IS the HPG acceleration alone. oracle_rhs_kt00000001.bin therefore supplies the same exact-input frame that oracle_input_hpg supplies on GYRE.
preconditions_that_must_hold_or_the_row_: the card's initial state equals NEMO's oracle_step_entry_kt00000001 T/S/u/v/ssh with 0 unequal wet cells
NEMO's entry u and v are identically zero, so the row cannot pass by cancellation between HPG and a nonzero vorticity or advection term
rule12_eligibility.prediction: 0 unequal wet faces and 0.0 absolute maximum on U and V for both LOCK_EXCHANGE-zco and OVERFLOW-zps.
rule12_eligibility.confirm: Both cards report 0 / n on both components with both preconditions satisfied; Rule-12 eligibility for the round-25 change is then discharged on all lane-1 cards.
rule12_eligibility.refute: Any nonzero residual, or a violated precondition, REFUTES eligibility on that card. It is reported as REFUTED and the round-25 change is registered as ineligible on that card. It is NOT softened, and no per-card switch is added.

lock_external_records.prediction: The three oracle_transport_kt00000001_s1/s2/s3 differences are confined to the pre-tra_adv_trp zFw workspace slot; every other byte range and all 24 remaining pre-existing records are byte-identical to lock_kt1_10.
lock_external_records.confirm: Byte-range decomposition places 100% of differing bytes inside the zFw slot and none elsewhere.
lock_external_records.refute: Any differing byte outside that slot refuses admission of the acquisition.
